violations.text: The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2026

There was no evidence that employees are required to report to the person in charge information about their health (illnesses, symptoms) as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food. Manager stated they are creating an employee handbook; inspector provided RIDOH guidance. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Inspector provided RIDOH guidance. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026
Staff were observed washing hands at the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

Hand washing signage and soap were observed placed at the 3-bay sink at the bar. 3-bay sink should be used for dish washing only; designated hand washing sinks shall be supplied with soap, paper towels, and proper signage. New Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. PIC provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. PIC provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026
Ice was observed in the hand-washing sink at the bar. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026
Staff were observed rinsing glasses in the handwashing sink at the bar. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the kitchen dishwasher was 25 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. New Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2026

Rice was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. PIC dated rice during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026
The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked. New Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2026
ROP tuna was observed thawing with packaging intact. PIC instructed staff to remove from packaging during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

Working containers of liquid ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2026
Staff cell phones were observed on food preparation tables. PIC move phones to other location. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

The concentration of the sanitizer solution for the wet wiping cloths at the bar was 0 parts per million (ppm). The required concentration for quaternary ammonium sanitizer is 200-400 ppm. Staff emptied sani bucket and refilled with sanitizer solution. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of salsa. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/17/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the refrigerators and table in dry storage room have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Staff began cleaning during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2026
A leak was observed at the waste line of the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 12/01/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen and bar were lacking paper towels. New Violation. Correct By: 05/23/2025
Hand washing signage was observed at the bar 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 05/23/2025

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the bar dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Technician arrived during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2025
The water connections to the bar 3-bay sink were not attached. Technician arrived during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2025
The floor and wall junctures in the bar area do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 05/23/2025
A light was observed non-functional at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 05/23/2025
